scope: Projection of all passed timed native observations from the four retained Metal ABBA reports, with their separately measured native peak-RSS samples; no new measurement.

units.counter_ranges: inclusive minimum and maximum across three original timed samples
units.phase_timings: host elapsed nanoseconds; median is the sorted middle of three samples; no GPU kernel-time claim
units.wall: fresh-process elapsed nanoseconds from timed captures
units.stdout_bytes: UTF-8 byte count of the retained complete native stdout capture
units.peak_accounted_bytes: conservative logical authored allocation accounting reported by the device API; not physical GPU residency or total process RSS
units.peak_rss_bytes: separate fresh-process memory sample; RUSAGE_CHILDREN as defined in report peak_rss scope; excludes device-memory measurement
units.gpu_work: primitive-specific charged work; baseline general propagation and candidate tight support have different units
units.absent_fields: Unavailable legacy fields remain absent; tight-support inapplicability remains null. No absent residual reason is treated as zero.
